title: Wordmark letters
slide_intent: Inspect letters individually because distinctive details can disappear when a word is viewed only as a whole.
strategic_value: The heavy irregular lowercase forms can give the Mailchimp name a memorable silhouette.
demonstration: A portrait yellow loop presents successive oversized black letters spelling the brand name at different positions.
practical_value: Compare the wordmark’s individual curves, counters and terminals.

content_islands.name: Letter specimen
content_islands.spec: Show one large letter at a time against the yellow field, retaining the changing position.

reference_purposes.Expression: The sequence isolates the custom-looking lowercase forms of the name.
